subject.title: feat(ui): Labs settings page for experimental feature toggles

question: Should OpenClaw add and maintain a shared Settings → Labs surface for experimental feature toggles, beginning with Code Mode?
rationale: This is a new discoverability and configuration-management surface rather than a repair to an established UI contract; its intended scope and future ownership cannot be inferred safely from the implementation alone.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow Code Mode Labs page
options.body: Approve Labs as the controlled home for existing experimental toggles, while requiring the snapshot repair and live Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Keep experimental toggles in existing setup paths
options.body: Decline the shared Labs surface and close or narrow the PR to any independently useful navigation or localization work.

options.title: Defer Labs pending a broader experimental-settings design
options.body: Pause this PR until an owner defines registry ownership, admission criteria, and the relationship to future Swarm controls.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow Code Mode Labs page
recommendation.body: Approve Labs as the controlled home for existing experimental toggles, while requiring the snapshot repair and live Gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the proposed UI and the linked experimental-feature program that supplies its stated product rationale.
